english.note: Central IELTS minimum has no subscore below 5; PTE Academic 55 with no subscore below 53. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; consult official policy and program-specific requirements.

documents: Official transcript of all undergraduate and graduate coursework
English translations of non-English academic credentials
requirements.note: Biology or acceptable subdiscipline bachelor's degree and undergraduate GPA 3.0 required. Faculty agreement to serve as major professor required before formal admission. GRE optional and not used for funding decisions. A non-refundable application fee is required; amount not stated on opened central pages. Limited departmental fee waivers may be available case by case; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

funding.note: Faculty-funded research assistantships may be available; a small number of top admitted applicants are nominated for university fellowships with stipend, tuition remission and health insurance. No universal guarantee stated.
